definitions.explanation: The enclosed grounds of a temple or shrine, including the area within the boundary of the religious site. Often includes gardens, paths, secondary buildings, and sometimes cemeteries.

examples.japanese: {境内|けいだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{咲|さ}いている→咲く：08150_saku⟧。
examples.english: Cherry blossoms are blooming on the temple grounds.

examples.japanese: ⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{境内|けいだい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{初詣|はつもうで}→初詣：05804_hatsumoude⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{参拝客|さんぱいきゃく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいた→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: Visitors for the New Year shrine visit were lining up on the shrine grounds.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{寺|てら}→寺：01676_tera⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{境内|けいだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{樹齢|じゅれい}→樹齢：23245_jurei⟧{三百年|さんびゃくねん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧⟦{大木|たいぼく}→大木：04498_taiboku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: On the grounds of this temple, there is a great tree over three hundred years old.

notes:
USAGE:
Used for both Buddhist temples (⟦{寺|てら}→寺：01676_tera⟧) and Shinto shrines (⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧). The {境内|けいだい} is the area within the sacred boundary, distinct from the surrounding neighborhood. Many temple and shrine grounds in Japan are open to the public and serve as parks and community spaces.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {境内|けいだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: enter the precincts
- {境内|けいだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{散策|さんさく}→散策：07618_sansaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: stroll through the grounds
- ⟦{寺|てら}→寺：01676_tera⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{境内|けいだい}: temple grounds
- ⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{境内|けいだい}: shrine precincts
- {境内|けいだい}マップ: grounds map
